name: FreshQA
description: A dynamic question answering benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on questions requiring fast-changing world knowledge and the ability to debunk false premises, with a two-mode evaluation for correctness and hallucination.
reputation: A newer dynamic QA benchmark that has gained attention for testing freshness of knowledge and resistance to hallucinated assumptions.
notes: Includes human evaluations with over 50K judgments; benchmark is regularly updated.
